name: Video To Blog
author: Video To Blog

sections.description:
Instantly convert videos into amazing blog posts complete with video screenshots, internal/external links, SEO optimization, and so much more.

Video To Blog can be used to repurpose your YouTube videos, podcasts, webinars, audio recordings, and transcripts.

Using this Video To Blog plugin you can export your blog posts directly to your WordPress site.

When exporting, the plugin will:

  • Upload images from VideoToBlog to your WordPress Media Library and swap the URLs in your content.
  • Preserve image SEO metadata when available (alt text, captions and SEO-friendly filenames).
  • Send SEO metadata compatible with popular SEO plugins (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress, All in One SEO), as well as generic Open Graph and Twitter metadata.

A quick installation guide can be found here: Video To Blog.

External services

This Plugin Connects your WordPress site to your videotoblog.ai account for publishing AI-generated blog posts to your WordPress site.

When you connect, your site URL, site name, and token are shared for authentication. Blog posts are published to your WordPress site only when exported from videotoblog.ai.
This service is provided by “Video to Blog”: terms of use, privacy policy.

Privacy: No personal data is shared unless you explicitly export content. No third-party tracking is involved.

Privacy

This plugin does not track or store personal user data. It only communicates with the VideoToBlog API when explicitly connected.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send any data to external services?

Yes. When you connect your site to your VideoToBlog account, the plugin securely sends your site URL, site name, and token to https://videotoblog.ai in order to verify and register your connection.
No personal user data, post content, or analytics are transmitted unless you explicitly export a post or image.

What happens when I disconnect or uninstall the plugin?

When you uninstall the plugin, your stored token is removed from your WordPress database. No further communication occurs with VideoToBlog.

Is my data shared with any third parties?

No. The connection is only between your WordPress site and VideoToBlog’s secure API. No third-party tracking or analytics are included.

Does this plugin work with SEO plugins?

Yes. When you export a post, VideoToBlog sends both generic meta tags (meta description, Open Graph, Twitter card) and plugin-specific meta keys for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress and All in One SEO. This means your SEO plugin should automatically pick up the title and description that VideoToBlog generated for you.

How are image alt text, captions and filenames handled?

When possible, VideoToBlog sends alt text, captions (including from <figure><figcaption>) and an SEO-friendly slug for each image. The plugin will use these values when creating media items in your Media Library, and will update the image URLs in the exported content to point to the new attachments.
sections.changelog:
1.4.15

  • Improved security: Use hash_equals() for token comparison to prevent timing attacks
  • Improved error handling: All errors now properly returned to VideoToBlog for centralized logging
  • Fixed authentication: Changed invalid token status code from 403 to 401 (correct HTTP semantics)
  • Enhanced image upload error handling with detailed error messages
  • Improved disconnect message handling to display backend error messages correctly
  • Wrapped export and image upload handlers in try-catch for better exception handling

1.4.14

  • Fixed connection callback to properly update plugin UI after approval
  • Fixed plugin state cleanup on deactivation and reactivation
  • Added version warning for users with older plugin versions when exporting categories
  • Improved connection reliability and error handling

1.4.13

  • Add category assignment support for exported posts
  • Categories are now properly assigned when exporting posts via the plugin

1.4.12

  • Apply image SEO metadata (alt, caption, slug) to uploaded images
  • Align SEO meta fields with legacy WordPress.org integration (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO)
  • Preserve CTA layout when exporting as Gutenberg blocks
  • Harden REST handlers and fix header-output login issue on some hosts

1.4.3

  • Relaxed connection success parsing: treat 2xx + boolean true or status “ok” as success.
  • Bump versions to align trunk and tag.

1.4.0

  • Initial public release.

  • Fix metadata saving in post export
  • Add error callback handler and better admin error messages
  • Make backend base URL configurable (defaults to production)
  • Use current user for post author (fallback to 1)
  • Fix settings page HTML and dedupe connect handler
  • Align versions and minor resilience improvements

1.4.11

  • Metadata persistence fix for exports
  • Add error callback handler and better admin error messages
  • Configurable backend base URL (defaults to production)
  • Use current user as post author (fallback to ID 1)
  • Admin connect status polling + auto-clearing success text
  • Dedupe admin connect handler and align script version
  • Add timeouts/retries and basic rate limit on disconnect endpoint
